logs.title: Logs
logs.notConfigured: Logs are only available in the Windows service
logs.notConfiguredHint: The service passes the folder with service.log, app.log and the logs of the EPLAN worker to the app via NUXT_LOG_DIR. Here the app runs without this folder (for example during development).
logs.unreadable: The log folder is not readable
logs.unreadableHint: Please check that the folder exists and the service account may read it.
